objective: Al terminar demuestras el nivel A2: hablas de tus aficiones y tiempo libre, y usas el vocabulario y la gramática de todo el nivel.

warmup.prompt_es: Checkpoint final de A2: junta aficiones, frecuencia, clubes, adjetivos -ed / -ing y vocabulario de todo el nivel.

input.recap_es: Repasa: play / go / do, how often, apuntarte a un club, hablar de tu afición, adjetivos -ed / -ing, y el vocabulario de todo A2.

md_es: - *How often do you …? · twice a week · hardly ever · never*
- *I'd like to join … · How much is the membership? · Is there a discount?*
- *My hobby is … · I've played for … · What I like most … · It helps me relax*

exercises.prompt: Une cada palabra con su categoría (vocabulario de todo A2).

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Es el ejercicio clásico de clasificar vocabulario por categorías.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Es el ejercicio clásico de clasificar vocabulario por categorías.

exercises.prompt: I ___ swimming every morning. (voy a)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Go + -ing: go swimming.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Después del comparativo se usa than.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Después del comparativo se usa than.

exercises.prompt: I play tennis ___ a week. (dos veces)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Twice = dos veces.

exercises.prompt: I'd like to ___ the gym. (apuntarme a)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Join = apuntarse, unirse.

exercises.prompt: I've worked here ___ 2019.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Since + año.

exercises.prompt: The film was really ___. (aburrida)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: La película (cosa): boring.

exercises.prompt: I've got a ___. My head is very hot. (fiebre)

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Temperature también significa fiebre.

exercises.prompt: I do ___ every Sunday.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Do + actividad individual: do yoga.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Con he/she/it el verbo lleva -s.

exercises.prompt: Elige la frase correcta.
options: I hardly ever go to the gym.
I go hardly ever to the gym.
I don't hardly ever go to the gym.
I hardly ever to go the gym.
answer: I hardly ever go to the gym.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! El adverbio va antes del verbo.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: El adverbio va antes del verbo.

exercises.prompt: Elige la frase correcta.
options: I was born in 1995 and I've lived here since 2019.
I am born in 1995 and I live here since 2019.
I born in 1995 and I've lived here for 2019.
I was born in 1995 and I live here since 2019.
answer: I was born in 1995 and I've lived here since 2019.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Was born + present perfect con since.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Was born + present perfect con since.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: Could you tell me where is the post office?
answer: Could you tell me where the post office is?

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Orden afirmativo.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: It makes me to feel happy.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Make + persona + verbo base.

exercises.prompt: Hay un error. Escribe la frase correcta.
exercises.text: I was very bored by the film because it was bored.
answer: I was very bored because the film was boring.
I was very bored by the film because it was boring.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Película: boring; yo: bored.

exercises.prompt: ___ you Spanish? — No, I'm not.

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Con 'you' la pregunta empieza con 'Are'.

exercises.prompt: ¿Desde cuándo nada?
exercises.audio_text: I play tennis twice a week and I go swimming on Sundays. I've played tennis for ten years, but I started swimming only last year.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Dice 'I started swimming only last year'.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Dice 'I started swimming only last year'.

exercises.prompt: Juego al ajedrez desde hace diez años y me ayuda a relajarme.
answer: I've played chess for ten years and it helps me relax.
I have played chess for ten years and it helps me relax.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Present perfect con for + helps me relax.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Present perfect con for + helps me relax.

exercises.prompt: Horario fijo: 'The train ___ at 9:10.'

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Para horarios se usa presente simple.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Para horarios se usa presente simple.

exercises.prompt: Escribe un párrafo de 7 u 8 frases sobre tu tiempo libre: qué actividades haces, cada cuánto, desde cuándo, qué te gusta y qué te gustaría probar.
self_check_es: ¿Usaste for o since con present perfect?
¿Hablaste de algo que te gustaría hacer?
exercises.model_answer: In my free time I play tennis twice a week and I go swimming on Sundays. I've played tennis for five years. What I like most is that it helps me relax. I hardly ever go to the gym because I find it boring. One day I'd like to try hiking.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Compara tu texto con el modelo y la lista de control.

exercises.prompt: Une cada adjetivo con su adverbio.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Casi todos añaden -ly; good y fast son especiales.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Casi todos añaden -ly; good y fast son especiales.

exercises.situation_es: Hablas de tu tiempo libre con un compañero de clase.

turns.speaker: Classmate
turns.text: What do you do in your free time?

turns.speaker: You
choices: I play tennis twice a week and I go swimming on Sundays.
I play tennis two times a week and I play swimming on Sundays.
I do tennis twice and I swim of Sundays.
turns.why_es: play + deporte; go + -ing; twice a week.

turns.speaker: Classmate
turns.text: That's great! How long have you played tennis?

turns.speaker: You
choices: I've played tennis for five years. It helps me relax.
I play tennis since five years. It helps me to relax.
I am playing tennis five years ago. It relaxes me.
turns.why_es: Present perfect + for; helps me + verbo.

feedback.correct: ¡Correcto! Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.
feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: Practica diciendo en voz alta tu parte.

exercises.prompt: What do you ___ about group projects?

feedback.incorrect: Revisa esto: What do you think about …?
